# Portalis Interiors

> Portalis Interiors LLC is an interior fit-out company based in Ajman, United Arab Emirates. We handle design, authority approvals, MEP and joinery for restaurants, cafés, retail and offices across the UAE, with one team from first drawing to handover.

## Company
- Legal name: Portalis Interiors LLC
- Also known as: Portalis Interiors, Portalis
- Location: Industrial Area 2, Ajman, United Arab Emirates
- Serves: United Arab Emirates
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 522 2074
- Email: info@portalis.ae
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 18:00
- Website: https://portalis.ae
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/portalis.ae
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591353571001
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/portalis-interiors-llc/

## Services
- [Design development](https://portalis.ae/services/design-development): plans, 3D visuals and material specifications ready for site
- [Turnkey projects](https://portalis.ae/services/turnkey-projects): one team responsible from first drawing to handover
- [Corporate interiors](https://portalis.ae/services/corporate-interiors): offices planned for focus, acoustics and the way your team works
- [MEP systems](https://portalis.ae/services/mep-systems): AC, lighting, power and plumbing coordinated with the design
- [F&B and hospitality](https://portalis.ae/services/fb-hospitality): restaurants, cafés and lounges built to work as hard as they look
- [Retail and wellness](https://portalis.ae/services/retail-wellness): shops, salons, spas and clinics, from storefront to treatment room
- [Joinery services](https://portalis.ae/services/joinery-services): bespoke woodwork, panelling and furniture made to fit the room
- [Approvals and compliance](https://portalis.ae/services/approvals-compliance): permits and authority approvals handled, so opening day isn't held up
